qualification: local pinned-fixture correctness and production-admission evidence; not hardware, cross-host, G1-G5, or release qualification

admission.lowering: The exact byte SHR performs one replay-safe byte read, computes the result before a final transactional byte write, and publishes its lazy SHR flags descriptor only after the write succeeds.
admission.boundedRule: The measured RIP, complete three-byte single instruction, logical-right operation, byte width, immediate count one, RSI base, 0x19 displacement, and 64-bit address width must all match. An adjacent RIP or changed displacement declines.

verification.focusedGate: The exact byte memory-SHR block passes its tier-one differential and rejected-write matrix.
verification.dbtPCAndRunnerGate: 1,496 tests in 175 suites passed; the pinned PVH environment test skipped because its environment variables were absent.
verification.differentialCoverage: Input bytes 0x00, 0x01, 0x80, and 0xff match the interpreter for complete state, resulting memory, and defined SHR-by-one flags.
verification.faultCoverage: A forced final-write rejection preserves complete block-entry state and memory after exactly one write attempt.
verification.negativeCoverage: An adjacent RIP and a changed displacement both decline tier one.

unmatchedPriorRunComparison.interpretation: The executions have different interrupt, compilation, trace, address-space, and instruction totals. Exact-site absence establishes production use; aggregate and elapsed movements are reported for completeness and are not a performance claim.

interpretation: The exact 5,039-hit byte memory-SHR site is absent from the candidate's capped live negative-cache sample. A05.2 remains open because 115,383 of 216,615 tier-one attempts still decline.
limitations: The complete workload evidence contains one candidate run on one local Apple M2 Pro.
The negative-cache sampler is capped and proves absence only from the retained visible list.
This evidence establishes no statistical performance delta and does not satisfy G1-G5.
